  * Exec engagement tracking & multithreading score
  * Rep performance insights without manual logging
  * Forecast prediction grounded in real activity

## Why choose Nektar
[ See Pricing ](https://nektar.ai/pricing/)
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/1-4.png)
### The only data layer that fixes history 
"Time Travel" retroactively corrects data as new context arrives. Most tools enrich going forward. We fix what already happened not just on go live but on an 'Always On' basis.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-3.png)
### Works across your entire stack 
Unlike other tools, that only captures what they record, Nektar is the neutral infrastructure layer that makes every platform smarter, not just one.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/3-4.png)
### No adoption needed
Your revenue teams don’t need to switch to a new UI. Nektar works behind the scenes, seamlessly.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/4-2.png)
### Your data stays yours
Everything syncs directly to your CRM in standard and custom fields. Nothing lives locked inside Nektar. You own every record.
## The Nektar Difference
The matching layer, self-healing architecture, and training data aren't features. They're the product. And they compound over time.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/neural-net.gif)
##### ML Engine
Proprietary Affinity Matching
Our entity resolution engine correctly associates communications, contacts, and activities with >97% accuracy. Competitors can't replicate this without the training data we've spent years building.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/hourglass.gif)
##### Architecture
### Self-Healing + Time Travel
Nektar retroactively corrects data as new context arrives. If an email is logged to an account today and tomorrow we learn it belongs to an opportunity, we fix it everywhere automatically. No other vendor has this.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/belt.gif)
##### Design
### Zero Rep Adoption Required
Fully automatic, no behavioral change from sales teams. This is deceptively hard to build. Salesforce can’t do it because they want reps in their UI. We built the infrastructure for the data to flow without human intervention.
![](https://nektar.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/digital-collaboration.gif)
##### Neutrality
### CRM-Agnostic by Design
Works across your entire stack. Salesforce’s Einstein Activity Capture is fundamentally conflicted; they’ll never build something that works for their competitors. Nektar is the neutral data layer the market needs.
